implementation_scope: independent durable unapproved account/task credit ceilings, opaque one-use dispatch permits, conservative held balances and exact original OS owner recovery

initial_failures_and_adjustments.issue: New native inspection variable shadowed an existing Main local
initial_failures_and_adjustments.fix: Use a distinct identityState local; native compilation and actual host cases passed

initial_failures_and_adjustments.issue: Corruption fixtures hit SQLite foreign-key protection before exercising the ledger
initial_failures_and_adjustments.fix: Disable foreign keys only in intentional fixture tampering; the production ledger verifies foreign keys and refuses damaged data

initial_failures_and_adjustments.issue: An exited Windows process can briefly be unreadable rather than proven absent
initial_failures_and_adjustments.fix: Keep the original state and held credits until bounded repeated exact-identity reads prove absent; no timeout-based assumption or forced termination

initial_failures_and_adjustments.issue: Completion digest accepted coercible values in the first implementation
initial_failures_and_adjustments.fix: Require a string digest before any state change; new malformed-completion regression passed in the final full suite

notes: The three independent hosts are child credit writers in the CLI probe: two contend and one exits after dispatch. The main CLI process also writes single-host rehearsal cases. Native identity helpers are not model Runtimes.

The rehearsal uses a fixed historical rate time, not a live authorization. Default ledger reservation and dispatch check current time; completed replay and recovery preserve stored observations after expiry.
Each SQLite case is an isolated experiment. Its synthetic account digest cannot authorize a real credential or prove a unique protected store across files, projects or hosts.
Completed receipts contain hashes and conditional usage, never a billing invoice or the model response text. Every completed, cancelled or ambiguous request retains its original rounded reservation.

The audit found no reserved/dispatching requests in retained owned stores and verified every distinct stored original writer identity absent. It does not claim to clean Runtime/AppContainer resources, which this probe never created.
Raw prompts, credential contents and SQLite ledger bytes are not embedded or archived. Source and narrow observations are archived by digest; original failed test logs remain available.

Actual account/gateway eligibility, server-enforced token and reasoning bounds, approved account budgets and protected unique store, quota/invoice reconciliation, real HTTPS, filesystem hard quota and full controlled recovery remain pending.
